268-the-octopus-a-story-of-california.description: A book by Frank Norris. It was the last half of September, the very end of the dry season, and all Tulare County, all the vast reaches of the San Joaquin Valley--in fact all South Central California, was bone dry, parched, and baked and crisped after four months of cloudless weather, when the day seemed always at noon, and the sun blazed white hot over the valley from the Coast Range in the west to the foothills of the Sierras in the east.

arxiv-2307-04751.title: Shelving, Stacking, Hanging: Relational Pose Diffusion for Multi-modal Rearrangement
arxiv-2307-04751.creator: Anthony Simeonov, Ankit Goyal, Lucas Manuelli, Lin Yen-Chen, Alina Sarmiento, Alberto Rodriguez, Pulkit Agrawal, Dieter Fox
arxiv-2307-04751.description: Abstract We propose a system for rearranging objects in a scene to achieve a desired object-scene placing relationship, such as a book inserted in an open slot of a bookshelf. The pipeline generalizes to novel geometries, poses, and layouts of both scenes and objects, and is trained from demonstrations to operate directly on 3D point clouds.

arxiv-2406-10622.creator: Zsolt Lángi, Shanshan Wang
arxiv-2406-10622.description: Abstract . The Honeycomb Conjecture states that among tilings with unit area cells in the Euclidean plane, the average perimeter of a cell is minimal for a regular hexagonal tiling. This conjecture was proved by L. Fejes Tóth for convex tilings, and by Hales for not necessarily convex tilings.

arxiv-2408-13359.title: Power Scheduler: A Batch Size and Token Number Agnostic Learning Rate Scheduler
arxiv-2408-13359.creator: Yikang Shen, Matthew Stallone, Mayank Mishra, Gaoyuan Zhang, Shawn Tan, Aditya Prasad, Adriana Meza Soria, David D. Cox, Rameswar Panda
arxiv-2408-13359.description: Abstract Finding the optimal learning rate for language model pretraining is a challenging task. This is not only because there is a complicated correlation between learning rate, batch size, number of training tokens, model size, and other hyperparameters but also because it is prohibitively expensive to perform a hyperparameter search for large language models with Billions or Trillions of parameters.

arxiv-2506-11798.title: Persona-driven Simulation of Voting Behavior in the European Parliament with Large Language Models
arxiv-2506-11798.creator: Maximilian Kreutner, Marlene Lutz, Markus Strohmaier
arxiv-2506-11798.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) display remarkable capabilities to understand or even produce political discourse, but have been found to consistently display a progressive left-leaning bias. At the same time, so-called persona or identity prompts have been shown to produce LLM behavior that aligns with socioeconomic groups that the base model is not aligned with.

arxiv-2509-11902.title: Testing n s = 1 n_{s}=1 in light of the latest ACT and SPT data
arxiv-2509-11902.creator: Ze-Yu Peng, Jun-Qian Jiang, Hao Wang, Yun-Song Piao
arxiv-2509-11902.description: Abstract It is commonly recognized that the primordial scalar spectral index n s n_{s} is approximately 0.96 − 0.975 0.96-0.975 , depending on the dataset. However, this view is being completely altered by the early dark energy (EDE) resolutions of the Hubble tension, known as the most prominent tension the standard Λ \Lambda CDM model is suffering from.

arxiv-2511-00208.description: Abstract This paper addresses the multivariable gradient-based extremum seeking control (ESC) subject to saturation. Two distinct saturation scenarios are investigated here: saturation acting on the input of the function to be optimized, which is addressed using an anti-windup compensation strategy, and saturation affecting the gradient estimate.

pmc-10655298.creator: Kenneth Bentum Otabil, María-Gloria Basáñez, Blessing Ankrah, Emmanuel John Bart-Plange, Theophilus Nti Babae, Prince-Charles Kudzordzi, Vera Achiaa Darko, Abdul Sakibu Raji, Lydia Datsa, Andrews Agyapong Boakye, Michael Tawiah Yeboah, Joseph Nelson Siewe Fodjo, Henk D F H Schallig, Robert Colebunde
pmc-10655298.description: BackgroundThe World Health Organization has proposed that onchocerciasis elimination (interruption) of transmission be verified in 12 (approximately a third) endemic countries by 2030. The strategy to reach this goal is based on ivermectin Mass Drug Administration (MDA) with high geographical and therapeutic coverage. In addition to coverage, high levels of treatment adherence are paramount.

pmc-10673548.title: Design of Trench MIS Field Plate Structure for Edge Termination of GaN Vertical PN Diode
pmc-10673548.creator: Sung-Hoon Lee, Ho-Young Cha
pmc-10673548.description: In this study, we developed an analytic model to design a trench metal–insulator–semiconductor (MIS) field plate (FP) structure for the edge termination of a vertical GaN PN diode. The key parameters considered in the trench MIS FP structure include trench depth, MIS dielectric material and thickness, and interface charge density of MIS.

pmc-11585246.title: Electrical impedance tomography guided positive end-expiratory pressure titration in critically ill and surgical adult patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11585246.creator: Yelin Gao, Huaiwu He, Yi Chi, Inéz Frerichs, Yun Long, Zhanqi Zhao
pmc-11585246.description: ObjectiveElectrical impedance tomography (EIT) has been used to titrate positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP). This study aims to develop a comprehensive view of the efficacy and long-term prognosis of EIT-guided PEEP compared to other conventional approaches in various clinical scenarios, including patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), hypoxemic acute respiratory failure (hARF) and patients undergoing surgery under general anesthesia.

pmc-11633273.title: Verification of Sub-national Claim for ‘TB-free’ Status of Rajsamand District, Rajasthan, India-2020
pmc-11633273.creator: Kalika Gupta, Mitin Parmar, Kush Davda, Shivangi Davda, Pooja Soni, Ashok K. Bhardwaj, Bhavesh Modi, Rajendra Awate
pmc-11633273.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Tuberculosis (TB) caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis is an opportunistic infection that affects the lungs in humans. Caseload of TB has been deemed it endemic in various regions of the world and India is on top of that list. The Government of India has set out a goal to eliminate tuberculosis in India by the year 2025 with the help of the National Strategic Plan (NSP) 2017–25.

pmc-12554399.title: Single‐Cell Transcriptomics of Human Pericarotid Lymph Nodes Indicating Stability of Carotid Atherosclerotic Plaques
pmc-12554399.creator: Tao Sun, Yanzhao Wu, Guohao Liu, Zhiwei Xue, Mengchen Yu, Bo Mao, Mengtao Han, Xiangjun Liang, Lu Ling, Nanlin You, Longxin Ji, Han Liu, Chenyang Xu, Zhen Qin, Peng Zhao, Donghai Wang
pmc-12554399.description: BackgroundThe link between lymph node (LN) function and atherosclerosis is unclear, especially at the single‐cell level. This study explores the relationship between pericarotid LNs and plaque stability using single‐cell transcriptome analysis.MethodsWe enrolled 106 patients with severe internal carotid artery stenosis undergoing carotid endarterectomy.

Kentucky) is a global challenge, with increasing resistance to cephalosporins, ciprofloxacin, and carbapenems significantly limiting treatment strategies, yet its worldwide dissemination patterns and AMR profiles remain unclear. Therefore, this study monitored the current trends in global spatiotemporal distribution and AMR of 9,557 S.

pmc-12703524.title: Impact of Clinical Pharmacy Team Intervention on Naloxone Fills in Patients on Chronic Opioid Therapy
pmc-12703524.creator: Rosy S Sijapati, Erin R Himes, Stephanie A Hale
pmc-12703524.description: BackgroundOpioids are highly effective for pain management but carry risks. Naloxone quickly reverses opioid overdoses by blocking opioid receptors in the brain. Despite its effectiveness, naloxone remains underutilized. Kaiser Permanente created the Interregional Pharmacy Opioid Use Improvement Group to support safe opioid prescribing and increase appropriate naloxone prescribing.

pmc-13231079.title: Nonlinear dual-frequency modulation QEPAS using a single laser for resolving overlapping spectral features
pmc-13231079.creator: Xiaowen Shen, Lei Yang, Chaofeng Sun, Yan Gao, Marilena Giglio, Angelo Sampaolo, Pietro Patimisco, Vincenzo Spagnolo, Lei Dong, Hongpeng Wu
pmc-13231079.description: Conventional single-frequency wavelength modulation spectroscopy faces inherent limitations in multi-component gas sensing, due to restricted detection dimensionality and unavoidable trade-offs in modulation parameters. To overcome these issues, we propose a Quartz-Enhanced Photoacoustic Spectroscopy sensing technique based on single-laser dual-frequency superimposed modulation.

pmc-13348245.title: Scalable high-temperature superconducting diodes enabled by intrinsic Josephson junctions
pmc-13348245.creator: Zihan Wei, Youkai Qiao, Yang-Yang Lyu, Da Wang, Tianyu Li, Leonardo Rodrigues Cadorim, Ping Zhang, Wen-Cheng Yue, Dingding Li, Ziyu Song, Zixi Wang, Yunfan Wang, Milorad V Milošević, Yong-Lei Wang, Huabing Wang, Peiheng Wu
pmc-13348245.description: Superconducting diodes, enabling nonreciprocal supercurrents, hold promise for dissipationless electronics and time-reversal-symmetry-broken physics. Developing platforms that combine high-temperature operation with scalable fabrication remains a critical challenge for the field. Here, we show that the intrinsic Josephson junctions naturally in the layered cuprate Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ offer a robust, lithography-compatible platform for high-temperature superconducting diodes.

pmc-13393230.title: Oral–gut strain sharing after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass: A canonical oral microbiome signature in the gut linked to hepatic and glycemic remodeling
pmc-13393230.creator: Bas Voermans, Koen Prange, Sjoerd Bruin, Yair Acherman, Egija Zaura, Max Nieuwdorp, Victor Gerdes
pmc-13393230.description: Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) induces durable weight loss and metabolic improvement, but the role of oral microbiota in shaping postsurgical gut ecology and metabolic outcomes is unclear. We examined whether RYGB promotes transfer and expansion of oral strains in the distal gut and how these relate to hepatic and glycemic health.
